{{Quote|Many years ago a female torton, her growth naturally stunted from birth, found her way into a cave not far to the Southeast of Narmle.|A biologist article on the Holonet|<ref name="10hotspots">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Travel%20Guide|text=10 Hot Spots Travel Guide}}</ref>}}
The '''Pygmy Torton Cave''' was a cave southeast of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was populated by pygmy [[torton]]s.

==History==
{{Quote|She found the cave an environment suitable to her needs: the passages were easy to defend, the proximity to the swamps allowed bountiful hunting, and the interior depths of the cave were a perfect place to incubate eggs. Due to the lengthy lifespan of the species many people say that the matriarch is still there, and since the many years have past, an impressive bale of tortons must inhabit the caves by now.|A biologist article on the Holonet|<ref name="10hotspots" />}}
[[File:PygmyTortonCave2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A pygmy torton lurking in the cave]]
A female [[torton]] which growth was naturally stunted from birth once found her way into this cave. She found it a suitable environment to lay eggs and gave rise to the the impressive pack of tortons that later inhabited the cave. Many years later, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], rumors said that the matriach still lived in the cave. A biologist published an article about the cave on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] by the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="10hotspots" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer visited the cave and found the weapon known as [[Darstai'is Sickle]].<ref name="SWG:RMWMII">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Melee Weapons Mark II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pygmy Torton Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PTC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Pygmy Torton Cave was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
